intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi toured the whole town and opened her first bank account! 💰
Now pack your bag — it's summer VACATION!

scenes.title: To the Top!
scenes.caption:
Huff... puff... the mountain is SO high.
But Kimi never gives up!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's go hiking. The air is fresh! 🌲

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The mountain is too high! My legs hurt. 😩

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's rest for a little bit. Go up carefully.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: We're finally at the top! Shout hooray! HOORAY! 📣

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It was hard at first, but it feels good here at the top. Say cheese! 📸

scenes.title: Sea, Sand & Salty Toes
scenes.caption:
Waves go WHOOSH, sand goes squish,
and tonight — a tent by the sea!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Wow, it's the sea! The waves are too high! 🌊

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Take off your shoes and go into the sea.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Bleh! The water's too salty! And the sand keeps getting in my shoes!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Want to set up the tent here? Let's set a fire tonight! ⛺

scenes.title: Splash! Pool Rules
scenes.caption:
Goggles on, swim cap on,
inner tube inflated — SPLASH!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Shower before you go in the pool. Don't forget your swim cap and goggles.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: All ready! Splash time! 🏊‍♀️

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't go into the deep end. Please don't dive. The floor is slippery, be careful.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Okay, Mom. No goofing around in the pool!

scenes.title: The Amusement Park Marathon
scenes.caption:
Merry-go-rounds, Ferris wheels, parades —
Kimi wants to ride EVERYTHING!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I want to ride the merry-go-round! 🎠

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wait in line. ...Oh, you're too short to ride this one.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The roller coaster looks too scary! I like the Viking Ride the most!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's ride the Ferris wheel and watch the parade. 🎡

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm dizzy... but I want to ride it again! 😵‍💫

scenes.title: Say Cheese!
scenes.caption:
Last day of vacation — time to capture
every happy memory!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's take a picture here. Everyone, squeeze together. Say cheese!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Cheese! 📸 Mom, take a picture of Minsu and me!

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Cheese! 🧀

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Make a big smile, please! ...Wow, it looks great!

scenes.title: The Piggyback Ride Home
scenes.caption:
Two tired little legs,
one warm, cozy back...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, my legs are SO tired... 🥺

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Come here, Sweetie. Let me give you a piggyback ride. Just lean on Mommy.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I can hear Mommy's heartbeat. 💓

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Why don't you sleep on Mommy's back? Sweet dreams, adventurer. 🌅

ending.title: Best. Vacation. Ever!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: What Day Is It? 🚌
